EmailTemplate.name: HR Lifecycle - Status Change
EmailTemplate.Body:
Hello,

The lifecycle status of the following identity has changed in SailPoint IdentityIQ.

Name$!displayName
Employee Number$!identityName
Previous Status$!oldStatus
New Status$!newStatus
Start Date$!startDate
End Date$!endDate
Job Description$!jobDescription
Manager$!managerName

This is an automated message from SailPoint IdentityIQ.
EmailTemplate.Description: Sent when an identity moves between PreHire, Active and Terminated.
EmailTemplate.Subject: Lifecycle change: $!displayName ($!identityName) is now $!newStatus
